title: Свадьба отменяется  (The Wedding Is Called Off)

segments.t: At the wedding arch, the officiant asks Nikita if he takes Katya as his wife, and Nikita gladly agrees. But when Katya looks into Nikita's eyes and receives Sveta's video message on her phone, she realizes she loves Denis and calls off the wedding.
Женщина может уйти в любой момент.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'We have gathered here for the sake of love.' In Russian, the idea of 'we' flows naturally into 'love' without extra filler words.
'We want to unite two loving hearts.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'want' and finishing on 'heart'.
'I want to address the newlyweds now.' Notice how Russian expresses 'want' and 'newlyweds' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Nikita, do you agree to take Ekaterina?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Nikita' and finishing on 'Ekaterina'.
'Yes, I completely agree.' Nikita brings out the contrast between 'yes' and 'I' in a few short words.
'Ekaterina, do you agree to marry Nikita?' Chef Barinov raises the pitch on 'for' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Katya answers right away.
'Forgive me, our wedding is called off today.' Katya brings out the contrast between 'forgive' and 'our' in a few short words.
'I do not understand, is this some kind of joke?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'not' before landing on 'joke'.
'Did we cook in vain today, or what?' In Russian, the idea of 'we' flows naturally into 'to cook' without extra filler words.
Женщина может уйти в любой момент.
'A woman can leave at any moment.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'woman' and finishing on 'moment'.
'Then I will probably go now.' Notice how Russian expresses 'then' and 'will go' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.

'Of course, there is no one left to marry here.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'of course' before landing on 'nobody'. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Женщина может уйти в любой момент.
Wait—is there really no one left to marry? Seeing the decorated hall and the officiant still standing there, Chef Barinov seizes the moment. See you next time!
